about: A web app for managing IP addresses and networks.

prs.title: Change history stays after the user who made it is deleted
prs.broken: Deleting a user also hid every change they had made from the address, subnet and section history pages.
prs.changed: I made those pages keep the entries and show them with a blank user name, as the main history page already did.
prs.matters: The record of who changed what on the network survives staff leaving.
